original_test_intent: Run the approved NVIDIA NVQual NT.1 ConnectX end-of-manufacturing qualification on the intended BlueField/ConnectX topology and show that every required item passed.
original_method: An authorized operator binds a pinned licensed NVQual build and resolved NT.1 EOM manifest to named ConnectX devices, ports, peers, cables and firmware, runs the documented workflow in an isolated topology, preserves per-item results and restores normal networking.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the licensed NVQual NT.1 procedure and topology; an authorized operator stages the physical peers/links, launches the pinned EOM workflow, monitors impact and reviews every item result.
required_inputs: NVQual package/version/hash, license and NVIDIA NT.1 document revision
Resolved ConnectX EOM case manifest and exact supported launcher/options
BlueField/ConnectX PCI BDF, port, PF/VF, firmware and driver mapping
Peer hosts/adapters, ports, cables/transceivers and link-layer configuration
Traffic paths/rates/directions/duration and isolation from production/management
Expected per-item outputs, limits, timeouts and all-items denominator
Privileges, storage and secure credential/host-key mechanism
Independent console, abort criteria, topology restoration and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not invent the deferred NVQual command or infer it from nvqual -h
Never use embedded passwords or disabled host-key verification
Authorize and isolate every peer, port and traffic path before launch
Protect the management/recovery path from test reconfiguration
Stop on unexpected link retrain/loss, peer impact, PCIe or packet error, data-integrity concern, thermal/power breach or console loss
Do not automatically retry a failed or timed-out item
agent_execution_scope: Verify package, manifest, device and topology identities
Collect secure read-only PCIe, firmware, driver, link and peer baselines
Preflight isolation, monitoring, storage and recovery readiness
Parse complete per-item results and independently verify the denominator
Perform no install, topology change, traffic launch, link reset, retry or verdict without approval
engineer_actions: Provide and approve licensed tool, exact NT.1 manifest/command and compatibility
Approve named topology, traffic limits, aborts and recovery
Define all-items denominator and skip/error handling
Review full per-item and restoration evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The help probe only checks that a binary responds; it is malformed/insecure as written and does not run ConnectX EOM. The authoritative command must come from the pinned vendor procedure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, use the exact NVQual NT.1 ConnectX EOM launcher against the resolved manifest and named topology, capturing complete output and exit status through secure access.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ConnectX EOM, all-items criterion, 15/300-minute estimates and vendor-tool dependency remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: PACKAGE-GATED CONNECTX EOM QUALIFICATION WITH TOPOLOGY-BOUND ITEM ACCOUNTING
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an immutable run manifest binding every NT.1 item to adapter/port/peer/cable identity, tool and firmware versions, traffic profile and result artifact; execute under independent link and platform monitoring.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact item expansion, topology identity, secure access, measurable traffic/limits and recovery without replacing the vendor workflow.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Binary help, inventory and a generic NVQual run cannot substitute for the NT.1 ConnectX EOM manifest or any missing item.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ConnectX EOM results depend on physical media, peer capabilities and per-port firmware configuration. A suite can pass on one active link while another required port or cable is absent unless the resolved manifest and topology are captured together.

project_override_considerations: Capability-based exclusions must name exact NT.1 item and physical reason and remain outside the pass numerator unless the authoritative vendor policy permits exclusion; row 1919 Test #21 evidence is not interchangeable.
expected_evidence: NVQual package/license/document hashes and resolved NT.1 EOM manifest
DUT/ConnectX/BlueField firmware-driver-device-port and peer/cable topology map
Complete per-item commands, outputs, exit codes, traffic/link counters, errors and timestamps
Independent total/pass/fail/skip/error calculation proving or disproving all-items-passed
Secure-access/no-hidden-skip/no-auto-retry audit, restored topology/health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently names ConnectX EOM and requires all items passed. The absent exact command and item manifest are package readiness inputs, not competing source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose and expected vendor workflow are identifiable; execution is package/topology-gated and can proceed when the licensed tool, manifest and authorized peers are supplied.

review_improvement: Replaces a malformed help-only SSH example with a secure, topology-bound, per-item qualification contract while preserving every EOM item and the five-hour machine estimate.
independent_technical_reasoning: An EOM network suite is only as complete as the physical port matrix it resolves at runtime. Device presence or one successful traffic path cannot prove media, lane and peer coverage across all required ConnectX ports. The run manifest must bind each result to immutable adapter, port and peer identities so a dynamically skipped link cannot disappear behind an all-items summary.
